description:
As a full stack web developer on the BAPI Web team you will be responsible for:
1. Developing new customer facing experiences 
2. Optimizing web experiences through continuous A/B testing and analytics
3. Defining and managing UX patterns and web standards 
4. Developing several new backend capabilities including WebAPIs and personalization support
5. Closely working with the Azure Web team to enhance the BAPI experiences 
6. Mentoring contributors across the BAPI group who are creating new pages and content
7. 5+ years of web development experience building and running large scale, production web sites
8. 4+ years of experience with ASP.NET MVC, Web APIs, C#, and the .NET Framework
9. 3+ years of experience with HTML5, JavaScript, and CSS/LESS
10. 2+ years of experience with popular JavaScript libraries such as React or Angular
11. Comprehensive experience using Git/GitHub
12. Experience with Microsoft Azure or similar cloud services
13. Excellent verbal and written communication skills
14. Blend of passion, creativity, and attention to detail for delivering an awesome web experience



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
years_evidence: 2+ years of experience with popular JavaScript libraries such as React or Angular
